title: PLAN Self-Contained Rounds
summary: Replace cross-PLAN ownership transfer and inherited execution context with one self-contained execution round per PLAN task. Preserve version 1 coordination as readable history, introduce a non-transferable version 2 registry for new PLAN work, and route missing historical context through separate read-only Historical Recovery Work.
expectedOutput: Approved design, implementation plan, version 2 coordination enforcement, legacy read-only compatibility, focused tests, full Project Control gates, and bounded Evidence without product or map-truth promotion.
riskSummary: The existing version 1 registry can represent ownership transfer and later generations. Migration must remove future mutation authority without invalidating historical records or accidentally treating legacy active wording as current execution authority.
